bias.zh: 强势上行 · 创收盘新高，超买

read.en: Berkshire Class A rose 0.5% on Nov 13 to $889,794, a record close and 3.9% higher on the week; Nov 12's $894,950 is the intraday high. It is above the 5-day ($877,889), 10-day ($864,314), 30-day ($817,476), 100-day ($774,284) and 200-day ($750,653) averages, all rising. MACD has been above its signal since Oct 8 and above zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Oct 8 ($861,364); RSI is 79.4, overbought.
read.zh: 伯克希尔 A 类股 11月13日上涨 0.5% 至 $889,794，创收盘新高，本周累计上涨 3.9%；11月12日盘中高点为 $894,950。股价位于 5 日（$877,889）、10 日（$864,314）、30 日（$817,476）、100 日（$774,284）和 200 日均线（$750,653）上方，均在上行。MACD 自 10月8日起位于信号线和零轴上方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看多（$861,364）；RSI 为 79.4，超买。

read.en: Resistance is $895K (Nov 12 high), then the round $900K. Support is $875.7K–877.9K (Nov 10 close, 5-day), then $861K–869K (SAR, 10-day, Nov 4 close) and $853.5K–856.6K (Nov 6 and Nov 9 closes). After an 11.5% gain in 20 sessions, a pause is likely; a close above $895K targets $900K and beyond, while a close below $861K would flip the SAR and point to $853.5K.
read.zh: 阻力位于 $895K（11月12日高点），其次为整数关口 $900K。支撑位于 $875.7K–877.9K（11月10日收盘、5 日均线），其次为 $861K–869K（SAR、10 日均线、11月4日收盘）及 $853.5K–856.6K（11月6日和 9日收盘）。20 个交易日上涨 11.5% 后可能整固；收盘站上 $895K 将指向 $900K 及以上，收盘跌破 $861K 则 SAR 翻空，指向 $853.5K。
